newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-FORMER ROMANIA COACH RETURNS TO UNIVERSITATEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FORMER ROMANIA COACH RETURNS TO UNIVERSITATEA.

text.p: Ex-Romania soccer trainer Mircea Radulescu has been appointed coach of his former first division club Universitatea Craiova, club officials said on Monday.

"We are glad to announce Radulescu's appointement and we hope to put the bad results of 1996 behind as soon as possible," said Universitatea vice-president Marcel Popescu, whose side finished near the bottom of the table last season.
Radulescu, who replaces Emeric Jenei, coached Craiova from 1984-86 and the Romanian national side from 1992-93.
Jenei left when he was appointed deputy sports minister late last year after four months in charge at Universitatea.
